oja-ledger.title: A changed naira breaks the chain
oja-ledger.why: Runs when the app opens: it recomputes every hash, so changing one old amount makes every later link fail.
oja-ledger.test: Proved by a property test that tampers with a random past entry in six ways

oja-ledger.title: “The books always balance” as a property, not an example
oja-ledger.why: fast-check generates 200 random ledgers per run and shrinks any failure to the smallest case. The first run caught a signed-zero bug in my own reversal test.
oja-ledger.test: Runs on every push in GitHub Actions

travel-stays.title: The database refuses the double booking
travel-stays.why: Two guests clicking “Book” in the same instant cannot both succeed, because Postgres rejects the overlap, not my app code. “[)” leaves the check-out day free for the next guest.
travel-stays.test: CI builds a fresh Postgres 16 from the real migrations and has 8 sessions book the same dates at once; exactly one may win

travel-stays.title: “The popup said success” is not proof
travel-stays.why: A pure function: the payment counts only if Paystack says it succeeded, the amount matches the server’s price to the kobo, and the currency is NGN.
travel-stays.test: 11 unit tests, including underpaying by one kobo and the wrong currency
